notes.title: Full voice update for characters!
notes.content: [p]"Thank you for all of your enjoyment of Sorry Survivor.[/p][p]We have just made a major update along with the full voice.[/p][p]For详细, the following contents are available![/p][p][/p][p]New CVs[/p][p] Makoto Ichizuno (ADV)[/p][p]Yukisa Tohu wing[/p][p]Mamba Gal[/p][p]Huuki-chan[/p][p]Otaku-chan[/p][p]Mob characters[/p][p]Some ADV are newly added.[/p][p]Bonus events for St01~St03[/p][p]St04 ・Addition of ADV during battle[/p][p]New dialogue added[/p][p]New dialogue at the beginning of the battle[/p][p]Warning to dead end[/p][p]Bonus event related dialogues[/p][p]Sorry Survivor" reading out loud in that ittle screen[/p][p]Other specific lines[/p][p]Additional modifications to functions[/p][p]Added “Auto” function to ADV part[/p][p]Tweaked some of the ADV content.[/p][p]Adjusted the volume of some data.[/p][p]It became already play.[/p][p][/p][p]Please enjoy this opportunity even if you have already played it.[/p][p]Thank you for your continued support![/p]
